calibration.source: Final 5 cold + 5 warm repeats after bounded startup prewarm on the frozen production database/board-cache protocol; Node v24.18.0, Chromium 151.0.7922.34, Playwright 1.62.1
calibration.notes: Timing ceilings were recalibrated from the final prewarm run with approximately 45-150% headroom over observed page-navigation maxima, while startup readiness is reported separately and is not folded into page budgets. Payload and contract ceilings retain the prior optimized limits. The paginated roles contract intentionally budgets 8 initial items, one roles request, one changes request, zero legacy /api/data requests, and a bounded card DOM. totalJobsAvailable is reported but not budgeted because it is fixture/data dependent. Recalibrate after intentional contract, fixture, browser, or hardware changes.

timeToUsableCardsMs.rationale: Final prewarm five-repeat page-navigation range 52.6-97.7 ms; 250 ms leaves over 2.5x headroom while keeping a regression signal. Server startup/readiness is reported separately.

shellFcpMs.rationale: Final five-repeat range 28-60 ms; 120 ms leaves 2x headroom for the representative desktop viewport.

lcpMs.rationale: Final five-repeat range 28-60 ms for the shell's largest content; 120 ms retains 2x rendering headroom.

apiListTtfbMs.rationale: Final prewarm five-repeat range 25.8-26.9 ms; 150 ms leaves over 5x headroom while detecting list/index regressions after startup prewarm.

apiListCompletionMs.rationale: Final prewarm five-repeat range 26.2-27.5 ms; 150 ms leaves over 5x headroom while keeping list completion within the usability path.

apiListBodyBytes.rationale: Observed 15,467-byte compact page; allows schema metadata drift without returning the pre-optimization full dataset.

apiListTransferBytes.rationale: Latest integrated five-repeat range 2,643-2,658-byte compressed page; preserves the compact/compressed response contract.

changesTtfbMs.rationale: Final five-repeat range 8.9-10.3 ms; 100 ms allows substantial local metadata variance while keeping the changes poll lightweight.

changesCompletionMs.rationale: Final five-repeat range 9.2-10.7 ms; 100 ms allows substantial local metadata variance while keeping the changes poll lightweight.

changesBodyBytes.rationale: Observed 1,031-byte changes payload; leaves room for status metadata without making it a list payload.

initialJsBodyBytes.rationale: Latest integrated app scripts total 44,359 decoded bytes; approximately 24% headroom for intentional client additions.

initialJsTransferBytes.rationale: Latest integrated app scripts total 44,752 wire bytes; preserves a small compressed static-asset budget.

initialApiBodyBytes.rationale: Observed 16,498-byte roles plus changes body; allows metadata growth while excluding eager details/full data.

initialApiTransferBytes.rationale: Latest integrated five-repeat range 3,347-3,361 compressed API bytes.

initialBodyBytes.rationale: Latest integrated five-repeat range 90,672-90,694 decoded initial bytes; allows static/API drift while remaining far below the old multi-megabyte list.

initialTransferBytes.rationale: Latest integrated five-repeat range 78,297-78,303 initial wire bytes; approximately 28% headroom for intentional assets.

requestCount.rationale: Observed six initial requests; two slots allow an intentional shell asset while catching duplicate list/poll fetches.

initialRolesRequestCount.rationale: The initial dashboard must issue one paginated roles request.

initialChangesRequestCount.rationale: The initial dashboard must issue one status/changes request.

legacyApiDataRequests.rationale: The optimized dashboard contract must not fall back to the legacy full-data endpoint.

initialJobsTransferred.rationale: The compact page contract is eight initial role cards; more indicates eager over-fetching.

initialCardsRendered.rationale: The frozen default view has eight usable initial cards.

domNodes.rationale: Observed 485 nodes with eight cards and lazy details; approximately 44% room for accessible shell changes without restoring the old unbounded DOM.

cls.rationale: Observed CLS 0.0822; retains headroom while keeping layout instability well below the old 0.476 baseline.
